+class FastQueueEmpty(Exception):
+    """Exception raised when FastQueue is empty."""
+    pass
+
+
+class FastQueue:
+    """
+    A fast, lock-based queue implementation optimized for performance.
+    
+    This queue uses collections.deque internally which is more efficient
+    than queue.Queue for simple producer-consumer patterns, especially
+    when used with small timeouts.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self):
+        self._queue = deque()
+        self._lock = threading.Lock()
+        self._not_empty = threading.Condition(self._lock)
+
+    def put(self, item: Any, block: bool = True, timeout: Optional[float] = None) -> None:
+        """Put an item into the queue."""
+        with self._lock:
+            self._queue.append(item)
+            self._not_empty.notify()
+
+    def get(self, block: bool = True, timeout: Optional[float] = None) -> Any:
+        """
+        Remove and return an item from the queue.
+        
+        Args:
+            block: Whether to block if queue is empty
+            timeout: Timeout in seconds (only used when block=True)
+            
+        Raises:
+            FastQueueEmpty: If queue is empty and block=False or timeout expires
+        """
+        if timeout is None:
+            timeout = float('inf')
+        
+        deadline = time.time() + timeout
+        
+        with self._not_empty:
+            while not self._queue:
+                remaining = deadline - time.time()
+                if remaining <= 0:
+                    raise FastQueueEmpty()
+                self._not_empty.wait(remaining)
+            return self._queue.popleft()
+
+    def qsize(self) -> int:
+        """Return the approximate size of the queue."""
+        with self._lock:
+            return len(self._queue)
+
+    def empty(self) -> bool:
+        """Return True if the queue is empty."""
+        with self._lock:
+            return len(self._queue) == 0
+
+
 class DisaggregationMode(Enum):
     NULL = "null"
     PREFILL = "prefill"
